Taking screenshots needs GAR\'s screenshot service, which is off. Open Accessibility settings?
The service only takes a screenshot when you ask GAR for one. It doesn\'t read your screen, and Android saves the screenshot like the buttons do.
Turn on GAR screenshots under Downloaded apps. If Android says it\'s a restricted setting, open GAR\'s app info, tap the menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Turn on GAR screenshots there, then ask again.

Lets GAR take a screenshot when you ask it to (\"take a screenshot\"). It does nothing else: it doesn\'t read what is on your screen, doesn\'t see what you type or tap, and doesn\'t get the screenshot, which Android saves like the buttons do.
